## 图片内文字

SPEVIGO® (Spesolimab):- License out

• Boehringer Ingelheim will grant global licensing rights for SPEVIGO® to LEO Pharma on 1 Oct 2025.

• Boehringer Ingelheim and LEO Pharma will collaborate closely to ensure continuity in the ongoing clinical programs for GPP and PG during the transition period.

（右侧文件/信件截图）
14.07.2025  
SC-CRP-18230  

Information about establishment of SPEVIGO® (spesolimab)  
Licensing Agreement  

Dear Healthcare Professional,

We would like to inform you of an important development regarding SPEVIGO® (spesolimab): Boehringer Ingelheim will grant global licensing rights for SPEVIGO® to LEO Pharma, a company with over 60 years of extensive expertise in dermatology.

With this agreement, SPEVIGO® has the potential to reach more patients than ever before. SPEVIGO® is currently available in more than 40 countries, and we remain committed to ensuring a smooth transition to maintain patient access and continuity of care. LEO Pharma’s strong relationships with providers, payers, and patients in the dermatology community make them an ideal partner to advance SPEVIGO®.

Boehringer Ingelheim and LEO Pharma will collaborate closely to ensure continuity in the ongoing clinical programs for Generalized Pustular Psoriasis (GPP) and Pyoderma Gangrenosum (PG) during the transition period.

As we start preparation for the transition of SPEVIGO® to LEO Pharma, we would like to assure you that this process is being undertaken with full confidence in maintaining the same care, dedication, and purpose that has defined our journey thus far.

## 视觉关系

- 页面主题为“License out”：左侧两条要点说明“授权给LEO Pharma”的关键事实；右侧为对应的正式信函截图（同一事件的书面通知/佐证）。
- 时间信息：要点中给出“1 Oct 2025”作为授权生效/授予日期；右侧信函顶部给出“14.07.2025”作为信件日期。
- 事项之间的关系：授权（grant global licensing rights）与“transition period（过渡期）”相连；过渡期内双方“collaborate closely”以确保“ongoing clinical programs for GPP and PG”的连续性。
